title: Meeting Whitley Strieber in Politically Incorrect green room

tellings.quote: Streamer. Yeah. I met him in the green room at Bill Maher's show.

plain: The skeptic Michael Shermer says that in the 1990s he met the writer Whitley Strieber, author of Communion, a book about Strieber's reported meetings with strange beings, in the green room of Politically Incorrect, the TV talk show hosted by Bill Maher. Shermer tells it as his own memory, in a debate about UFOs where he also brings up Budd Hopkins, a man who collected accounts of people who said they were taken by aliens.
